# New-ZbxImage

## SYNOPSIS

Creates an image.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxImage [[-Name] <string>] [[-ImageType] <ZabbixImageType>] [-ImageData <string>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

An image is an icon or a background picture that maps and map elements show, stored on the server as PNG data. The New-ZbxImage cmdlet sends image.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new image back with image.get and writes it. The server requires -ImageType, -Name and -ImageData; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create an image

```powershell
$png = (Get-ZbxImage -Name 'Server_(96)' -SelectImage).ImageData
New-ZbxImage -Name 'Rack' -ImageType Icon -ImageData $png
```

Creates an image named Rack. -ImageData is the PNG as Base64 text, here a copy of a stock icon; [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes('rack.png')) reads one from a file.
